title: Model Portfolios Stay Hot as LPL Launches New Suite
excerpt: The move comes amid increased demand for personalization and a flurry of other recent launches.
content_html:
You can find original article here WealthManagement. Subscribe to our free daily WealthManagement newsletters.

LPL Research, an independent investment and market strategy team within broker/dealer LPL Financial, has launched 17 new model portfolios as part of what it is calling its Building Block Model Portfolios suite.

The firm's model portfolio platform now features 70 variants and recently surpassed $100 billion in AUM.

In a blog post, Garrett Fish, head of model portfolio management, outlined what LPL is aiming to achieve with its building block model portfolios.

"Rather than delivering broad exposure across many asset classes in a single package, each building block targets a single asset class or a specific outcome—and each is a purpose-built, professionally managed strategy that can stand on its own," Fish wrote.

The new products span equities, fixed income and alternatives, and include separately managed accounts and strategies built with ETFs and mutual funds. The models can be used individually or combined into a unified managed account.

"Grounded in our research and asset allocation expertise, these modular solutions are designed to help build more personalized portfolios and adapt investment strategies to reflect evolving client needs," LPL Chief Investment Officer Marc Zabicki said in a statement.

According to recent research from Broadridge Financial Solutions, model portfolios accounted for roughly a third of all assets held by retail intermediary channels in the first quarter of 2026. Broadridge projected that model portfolio AUM will reach $18.6 trillion by 2030. That aligns with forecasts from other firms, including Cerulli Associates and Morningstar.

In the most recent Wealth Management Invest podcast, Karl Desmond, senior client portfolio manager at Invesco, discussed how financial advisors are using pre-built and custom model portfolios, including how they can maintain input on asset allocation, manager selection and existing holdings while delegating more of the portfolio construction process.

In the blog post, Fish added that the decision to use single-asset building blocks was driven by advisors' demand for customization, flexibility and scale.

"Client portfolios have grown more complex—blending active and passive strategies, multiple managers, and a sharper focus on tax efficiency," Fish wrote. "In that world, advisors need components they can assemble deliberately, not one-size-fits-all products they have to work around."

Other recent model portfolio news has included Morningstar Wealth announcing it is working with Apollo, Franklin Templeton and J.P. Morgan Asset Management to launch a suite of public/private model portfolios; American Beacon Advisors and consulting firm Mercer Investments launching the Mercer & American Model portfolios combining thematic investing strategies, dynamic asset allocation and income-focused solutions; and Bitwise launching model portfolios focused on crypto ETFs. In addition, there is sentiment that UMAs and models will be key to continued alts adoption in the wealth space.

LPL Research 是经纪商/交易商 LPL Financial 旗下的独立投资和市场策略团队，推出了 17 个新模型投资组合，作为其所谓的 Building Block Model Portfolio 套件的一部分。

该公司的模型组合平台现已拥有 70 个变体，最近 AUM 超过 1000 亿美元。

在一篇博文中，模型组合管理主管 Garrett Fish 概述了 LPL 的目标是通过其构建块模型组合实现的目标。

菲什写道：“每个构建模块并不是在一个包中提供跨多种资产类别的广泛投资，而是针对单一资产类别或特定结果，并且每一个都是专门构建的、经过专业管理的策略，可以独立存在。”

新产品涵盖股票、固定收益和另类投资，包括单独管理的账户以及使用 ETF 和共同基金构建的策略。 这些模型可以单独使用，也可以组合到一个统一的管理帐户中。

LPL 首席投资官 Marc Zabicki 在一份声明中表示：“这些模块化解决方案以我们的研究和资产配置专业知识为基础，旨在帮助建立更加个性化的投资组合并调整投资策略，以反映不断变化的客户需求。”

根据 Broadridge Financial Solutions 的最新研究，模型投资组合约占 2026 年第一季度零售中介渠道持有的所有资产的三分之一。 Broadridge 预计，到 2030 年，模型投资组合的 AUM 将达到 18.6 万亿美元。 这与 Cerulli Associates 和 Morningstar 等其他公司的预测一致。

在最新的财富管理投资播客中，Invesco 高级客户投资组合经理 Karl Desmond 讨论了财务顾问如何使用预构建和定制模型投资组合，包括他们如何保持对资产配置、经理选择和现有持股的投入，同时委托更多的投资组合构建流程。

Fish 在博客文章中补充说，使用单一资产构建模块的决定是由顾问对定制、灵活性和规模的需求驱动的。

菲什写道：“客户投资组合变得更加复杂——混合了主动和被动策略、多名经理，并且更加注重税收效率。” “在那个世界里，顾问需要的是他们可以精心组装的组件，而不是他们必须解决的一刀切的产品。”

最近的其他模型投资组合新闻包括晨星财富 (Morningstar Wealth) 宣布正在与阿波罗 (Apollo)、富兰克林邓普顿 (Franklin Templeton) 和 J.P. 合作。 摩根资产管理公司将推出一套公共/私人模型投资组合； American Beacon Advisors 和咨询公司 Mercer Investments 推出了 Mercer & American Model 投资组合，结合了主题投资策略、动态资产配置和以收入为中心的解决方案； Bitwise 推出专注于加密 ETF 的模型投资组合。 此外，有人认为 UMA 和模型将是财富领域继续采用另类投资的关键。
